encoder_fact: LeWM encoder is framewise: _hidden flattens (b,t) and runs the ViT per frame, so a root encoding depends only on its own frame. Calling it on 64 images adds no temporal processing.
known_confounds_to_respect: Direct's real-successor score uses _encode_legacy, which appends each successor to the native 64-frame prefix; _encode_lewm encodes single frames. Direct differs in CONTEXT as well as spatial structure, width and objective. A short-prefix Direct is a labelled ablation, not a replacement.
